info.name: Optics Management - Complete API Collection
info.description: Complete API test cases for Optics Management System with Auto-Login

exec: if (shouldSkip) { console.log('⏭️ Skip auto-login:', currentRequest); return; }
if (token && expiry && Date.now() < parseInt(expiry)) { console.log('✅ Token valid'); return; }
if (err) { console.error('❌ Login error:', err); return; }

pm.test('Login OK', () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.code).to.eql(1000); pm.environment.set('access_token', d.result.token); pm.environment.set('token_expiry', Date.now() + 3600000); });
pm.test('Refresh OK', () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.result.token).to.exist; pm.environment.set('access_token', d.result.token); });
pm.test('Logged out', () => { pm.environment.set('logged_out_token', pm.environment.get('access_token')); pm.environment.unset('access_token'); pm.environment.unset('token_expiry'); });
pm.test('Product created', () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.result).to.exist; pm.environment.set('product_id', d.result.id); });
pm.test('Variant created', () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('variant_id', d.result?.id); });
pm.test('Order created', () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('order_id', d.result?.id); });
